value.rules_markdown:
- One responsibility per module; core types go in a module-local `types.rs`.
- Each port in `src/ports/` is one trait in one file.
- Declare every CLI subcommand even when its milestone has not landed.
- Presets are data, not code: adding a preset is a new folder, never a new module.
- Never edit the `vendor/tinyagents` submodule here; change it upstream and bump the pin.
- Declare examples explicitly in `Cargo.toml` with `required-features`.
- Keep the default build offline; put network needs behind features (`harness`, `github`, `serve`).
- Use rustfmt output and Rust 2024 idioms; `snake_case` modules/files, `PascalCase` types.
- Return `Result<T>` using the crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Open every file with a `//!` module doc describing its role and any feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code; note load-bearing flags or ordering and why.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use `///` so it becomes help text.
- Keep tests in-crate as `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`; move to sibling `test.rs` when they grow; no `tests/` directory.
- Provide every port an always-compiled offline mock.
- Cover lane behaviour with golden tests asserting findings that survive filtering, dedupe and capping.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file at 500 lines or fewer; split and link when it grows.
- The model never holds a write token; lanes run against a read-only checkout.
- Write credentials are minted only in `src/apply/` after every model call has returned.
- Contributor code is never executed; read the diff and tree only, no builds or scripts.
- Treat PR bodies, comments and diffs as untrusted input; fence and label them as data in prompts.
- A model verdict is advisory; only deterministic policy in `src/apply/` and `src/automerge/` may mutate GitHub.
- Report found secrets by type and location only; the value never reaches comments, summaries or logs.
- Use concise, imperative commit subjects; commit each coherent, validated slice on its own.
- Pull requests state what changed, any behaviour change, and how it was verified.
